t2_t3.title: Nepal Himalayan Surface-Change Investigation

quality.window_sha256_content: row-major native power, mask and numberOfLooks bytes
row-major native power, mask and numberOfLooks bytes

preprocessing: Windowed native-grid extraction; no resampling or mosaicking
Finite positive power; mask values 1–254; finite positive numberOfLooks
analysis.area_method: absolute affine determinant × CRS linear-unit factors; projected grid area
analysis.ranking: area descending, then absolute median change descending
analysis.sensitivity_note: ±10% of nominal cutoff, repeating identical cleanup; not confidence intervals

aoi.reason: Fixed 24 km square around the Kathmandu Valley and its northern hills, selected for geographic context and manageable processing before inspecting change. No event boundary is asserted.

limitations: NISAR L2 GCOV is PROVISIONAL; calibration and quality assurance are ongoing.
Radar backscatter change does not identify its cause. All regions are UNVERIFIED.
Speckle, soil moisture, vegetation, local incidence angle and terrain effects can create change.
Mask and number-of-looks quality gates are applied; no independent terrain, optical or event validation is available.
Areas depend on threshold and connected-region cleanup. Sensitivity is not statistical confidence.
Area is projected grid area in UTM, not ellipsoidal ground area; minor projection distortion is possible.
A fixed small AOI is analyzed; this is not a Nepal-wide disaster inventory.
